title: Utility Line Protection Plans Seasonal Calendar: Cold-Weather Amounts for Public-Way Restoration
content:
# Seasonal Calendar: Cold-Weather Amounts for Public-Way Restoration

Seasonal schedule for public sidewalk, curb and street restoration under the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

A property is in the frost territory when it lies in a state whose plumbing code sets a design frost depth of at least 36 inches for buried water lines across most of the state, because there the soil over a service line freezes deep enough in winter that excavation must break frozen ground: Alaska, Colorado, Connecticut, Illinois, Iowa, Maine, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New York, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Vermont, Wisconsin and Wyoming. The state is read from the first three digits of the ZIP code recorded for the property on the plan: 005, 010 through 069, 100 through 149, 480 through 629, 680 through 693, 800 through 831 and 995 through 999 are the frost territory, and every other ZIP code is outside it. Public-way cold-weather addition: on a property in the frost territory, a request placed in December, January, February or March adds the winter public-way addition, for the temporary asphalt patch that holds a winter cut until concrete can be poured in spring, and a request placed in November or April adds the shoulder-season public-way addition, for cold-weather concrete protection; a request on a property outside the frost territory, or placed in any other month, adds no cold-weather addition. The public-way cold-weather addition is added to the public-way restoration figure as a flat dollar amount.

## Calendar

| Month of the service request's request date | Property in the frost territory | Property outside the frost territory |
|---|---|---|
| December, January, February, March | $300.00 (winter) | none |
| November, April | $150.00 (shoulder season) | none |
| May through October | none | none |

## The frost territory by ZIP code

| First three digits of the ZIP code recorded for the property on the plan | Frost territory |
|---|---|
| 005 | yes |
| 010 through 069 | yes |
| 100 through 149 | yes |
| 480 through 629 | yes |
| 680 through 693 | yes |
| 800 through 831 | yes |
| 995 through 999 | yes |
| every other first three digits | no |

The first three digits are read with any leading zeros: a ZIP code of 00501 begins 005, and one of 01002 begins 010.

*Boundary readings of the ranges (hypothetical ZIP codes):* 00599 is inside and 00601 outside; 06999 inside and 07001 outside; 14999 inside and 15001 outside; 47999 outside and 48001 inside; 62999 inside and 63001 outside; 67999 outside and 68001 inside; 69399 inside and 69401 outside; 79999 outside and 80001 inside; 83199 inside and 83201 outside; 99499 outside and 99501 inside.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical requests)

- Property ZIP code 55401, request placed on 31 March: $300.00. The same property, request placed on 1 April: $150.00; on 1 May: nothing.
- Property ZIP code 63101, request placed in January: nothing, the property being outside the frost territory.
